eps.t: Franz Roll and the Lost Rainbow Hot Pants of Atraxes the Apple Bottomed
eps.o: Rock quests for an ancient artifact in order to prove he is worthy of working with his modeling role model, Franz Roll. Paper and Scissors compete to be more supportive of Rock in the hopes that one of them will head his entourage when he's famous.

eps.t: Paper and Pencil Tell a Joke
eps.o: Paper and Pencil tell a kind of funny joke at a party and chase the feeling of people finding them funny by telling it again and again.
Scissors hires an orchestra to follow him around and score his life, helping him attract a famous girlfriend.
The trio's old friend Shoot comes back to town, ready for more of his favorite activity: exhaustingly annoying competitions.
Rock starts his job as Franz Roll's assistant and learns just how demanding his role model truly is.
Paper believes he's been accepted into a prestigious college only to learn that he's been placed into the third grade, which is harder than he expected.
When Scissors convinces Lou the Landlord to quit, The Astonishing Catalina takes over and ruins his life.
When Scissors swallows a pinecone, Pencil uses a technological marvel – the origami robot – to enter his stomach.

eps.t: Scissors Sees an Inspirational Sports Movie
eps.o: Scissors sees an inspirational movie about a scrappy kid who defies the odds to become a football star and tries to do the same thing.
Rock, Paper, and Scissors must prove their superiority over the Rat Bros in an "altruistic-off" - a competition of doing good for society.
Scissors has a bad date with Lolly the pop star and becomes the most hated man on Earth.
Paper takes Rock and Scissors' cellphones so the trio can connect in real life, but it turns out to be the worst day ever to be off-the-grid.
Rock can't sleep, so Paper and Scissors must tell him a bedtime story, but he's hard to please.
Franz Roll mistakes Scissors for a dog and adopts him, growing close to him and making Rock jealous of their relationship.
Paper dreads his annual family get-together because his family is more accomplished than he is, so he hatches a plan to skip it.
Rock, Paper, and Scissors try to maintain their tradition of seeing every Moonami film on opening day.
The trio ends up before a spider judge and jury for attempting to squish a spider in their apartment.
Scissors thinks he's finally discovered his "thing" when he joins forces with the sleep-themed villain Dreamscape.
Rock is sick and can't lead the Robo Car Wash in the Car Wash Nationals dance competition, leaving it to Paper and Scissors.
